clusters.name: probe-derisk
clusters.executionModeRationale: Touches only the external probe repo; fully disjoint from the codex source, so it runs in parallel with the core-capture cluster. Its output (the decided replay field shape) gates the overlay-replay cluster.

clusters.name: core-capture
clusters.executionModeRationale: All edits are in codex-core and the shared patch-surface ledger; disjoint from the probe repo, so it runs parallel with probe-derisk. It must land before overlay-replay because replay needs captured/persisted reasoning items and shares the patch-surface ledger.

clusters.name: overlay-replay
clusters.executionModeRationale: Different crate (codex-copilot) than core-capture, but it consumes the probe's field-shape decision and the capture side's persisted items, and it shares the patch-surface ledger with core-capture, so it is serialized into Phase 2 after both Phase-1 clusters.
